items.title: Northrop Grumman (NOC) Lands Navy Radar Deal On Undervalued Stock Narrative
items.summary: Northrop Grumman (NOC) has secured a US$123.8 million contract from the U.S. Navy to produce 67 APG-85 radars for the F-35 program, providing production visibility through February 2031. The contract lands at a time when Northrop Grumman’s 1-year total shareholder return is down 12.7%, while the 3-year and 5-year total shareholder returns of 21.9% and 53.4% point to a stronger long-run record and indicate that recent momentum has faded. items.title: Is GE Aerospace's Lead Already In Its Stock Price?
items.summary: GE Aerospace (GE) earns the widest operating margin in a group of six peer companies, and it grows revenue faster than all but one of them. The market already charges for that lead. Yet over the past twelve months the stock has returned far less than RTX, a slower-growing rival. The quality is real. The question is how much of it you are already paying for.
